decisions.reason: It remained prominently marketed on its own page in both 2023 and 2024, which suggests it is a strategic aviation software offering with continued management support.
Its move from a simple website mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 indicates growing commitment and improving product-market relevance rather than withdrawal risk.

Although it gained a dedicated page in 2024, revenue and billing software is somewhat less core to an electrical equipment manufacturer than operations or equipment-linked tools, so the drop risk is higher but still below the keep threshold.
Apron equipment monitoring is closely aligned with the firm’s industrial and electrical equipment base, and its upgraded website presence in 2024 points to a strong likelihood of continuation.
